name: Charmaine Portelli (University of Malta economist)
detail: THINK magazine interview weighs a Maltese wealth tax and lists FDI and work-incentive objections; says only that asking the wealthiest to pay more seems logical. Not an endorsement.

name: Clyde Caruana (Minister for Finance)
detail: Told Newsbook in September 2023 that Malta is not considering a wealth tax.

name: Momentum (Arnold Cassola) economic platform, March 2025
detail: MaltaToday interview mentions a tax on vacant property speculation and lower corporate tax, nothing on wealth.
